ei.title: Christine and Leo at the Vet

fullPassage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, \u201CI think Leo has a minor infection.\u201D \u201CInfection? Will he be okay?\u201D asked Christine. \u201CWe need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,\u201D replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best. \u201CI'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,\u201D said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. \u201CThe tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.\u201D Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. ① As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. ② The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. ③ Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” ④ “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine.
questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet."

det.korean: 대기실에 다른 반려동물 주인들이 있다는 설명 다음에, 드디어 Leo의 차례가 왔다는 문장이 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: "waiting room" 뒤 → "Finally, it was Leo's turn"이 자연스럽게 연결
❌ ①: 병원 도착 직후 → 아직 대기실 언급 전
❌ ②: 대기실 설명과 차례가 너무 가까이 붙음
❌ ④: 이미 진찰이 끝난 뒤
det.tip: "Finally"는 기다림 후 순서가 왔다는 의미 → "waiting room" 다음이 자연스러움

questions.passage: “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. ① The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. ② Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. ③ She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. ④
questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit."

det.korean: Christine이 사랑과 관심으로 돌본 뒤, 시간이 지나면서 Leo가 기력을 회복했다는 결말이 마지막에 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④: 돌봄 설명 후 → "As the days passed"로 시간 경과 후 결과
❌ ①: 아직 집에 도착 전
❌ ②: 방금 집에 도착 → 아직 돌봄 시작 전
❌ ③: 돌봄 도중 → "days passed"는 시간 경과가 필요
det.tip: "As the days passed"는 시간 경과 표현 → 일련의 돌봄 행동 후 마지막에 위치

questions.passage: It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but __________________________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.

accept / for / had / it / she / the best / to / was

det.korean: "she had to accept it was for the best" → 그녀는 그것이 최선이라는 것을 받아들여야 했다.
det.analysis:
she(주어) + had to(~해야 했다) + accept(받아들이다) + it was for the best(그것이 최선이었다)
had to + 동사원형, it was + 전치사구
det.tip: had to + 동사원형(accept) + that절(it was for the best) — but 뒤 양보/대조 구문

questions.wa: she had to accept it was for the best
accept: she had to accept it was for the best
She had to accept it was for the best

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.

and / gradually / his / Leo / playful / regained / spirit / strength

det.korean: "Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit" → Leo는 점차 기력과 활기찬 기운을 되찾았다.
det.analysis:
Leo(주어) + gradually(부사) + regained(동사) + his strength and playful spirit(목적어)
부사 gradually는 동사 앞에 위치
det.tip: 주어 + 부사 + 동사 + 목적어(A and B) 순서 — gradually는 동사 수식 부사

questions.wa: Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit
accept: Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit
leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner ①<u>who</u> loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. ②<u>Concerned</u> for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently ③<u>examined</u> him. “We need to do some tests to see if he is ④<u>infecting</u>. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to ⑤<u>pick</u> up Leo.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ infecting → infected: "he is infected"(그가 감염되었는지)로 수동태가 되어야 한다. Leo가 감염을 "시키는" 것이 아니라 "된" 것이므로.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ infecting(능동/현재분사): 원문은 infected(수동/과거분사) → 감염되다(수동)
✅ ① who: 사람 선행사(a cat owner) + 주격 관계대명사
✅ ② Concerned: 감정 분사(과거분사) → 걱정하여
✅ ③ examined: 과거형 동사 → 올바름
✅ ⑤ pick: to + 동사원형 → 올바름
det.tip: infect: infecting(감염시키는/능동) vs infected(감염된/수동) — 사람이 감염의 대상이면 수동태

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. __________ for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Christine이 걱정을 느끼는 주체이므로 Concerned(과거분사)가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Concerned: 감정 분사(과거분사) → 주어가 감정을 느낌
❌ ① Concerning: ~에 관하여 / 걱정시키는(능동)
❌ ③ To concern: to부정사는 이유 표현에 어색
❌ ④ Being concerning: 진행형 + 능동 → 부적절
det.tip: 감정 분사: concerned(걱정되는/수동) vs concerning(걱정시키는/능동)

questions.passage: The waiting room was __________ with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "was filled with" = ~로 가득 차 있었다 → 수동태(과거분사 filled)가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ filled: was filled with = ~로 가득 차다(수동태)
❌ ① filling: 능동 → 대기실이 채우는 것이 아님
❌ ② fill: 동사원형 → was 뒤에 부적절
❌ ④ to fill: to부정사 → was 뒤에 부적절
det.tip: be filled with = ~로 가득 차다 — fill의 수동태

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry ①<u>companion</u>, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. She ②<u>desperately</u> hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” It was ③<u>heartbreaking</u> for Christine to leave Leo. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.” ④<u>Distressed</u> to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. As the days passed, Leo gradually ⑤<u>regained</u> his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: "곧 회복될 것"이라는 좋은 소식을 듣고 안도한(Relieved) 것이 맞다. ④ Distressed(괴로워하는)는 문맥에 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ Distressed(괴로워하는): 원문은 Relieved(안도한) → 좋은 소식 뒤 "rushed back to pick up"은 안도의 행동
✅ ① companion(동반자): 원문 일치
✅ ② desperately(간절히): 원문 일치
✅ ③ heartbreaking(가슴 아픈): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ regained(회복했다): 원문 일치
det.tip: Relieved(안도) ↔ Distressed(괴로움) — 좋은 소식 + 행동(pick up)의 맥락 판단

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. She ①<u>desperately</u> hoped Leo got the necessary care. The vet gently ②<u>examined</u> him and said he had a minor ③<u>infection</u>. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously ④<u>awaited</u> news about Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest. Leo gradually ⑤<u>deteriorated</u> his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: Christine의 돌봄으로 Leo가 기력을 회복했다(regained). ⑤ deteriorated(악화시켰다)는 문맥에 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ⑤ deteriorated(악화시켰다): 원문은 regained(회복했다) → 돌봄 후 회복 맥락
✅ ① desperately(간절히): 원문 일치
✅ ② examined(진찰했다): 원문 일치
✅ ③ infection(감염): 원문 일치
✅ ④ awaited(기다렸다): 원문 일치
det.tip: regained(회복) ↔ deteriorated(악화) — 돌봄 후 "playful spirit"을 되찾는 맥락

questions.passage: “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was __________ for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사랑하는 고양이를 병원에 두고 가야 하는 것은 가슴 아픈(heartbreaking) 일이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ heartbreaking(가슴 아픈): "had to accept" + "for the best" → 힘들지만 받아들여야 하는 상황
❌ ① exciting(흥미진진한): 이별 상황과 어울리지 않음
❌ ② convenient(편리한): 반대 감정
❌ ④ amusing(재미있는): 반대 감정
❌ ⑤ promising(유망한): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: heartbreaking + but accept = 힘들지만 받아들이다 — 대조 구조(but)가 단서

questions.passage: “I'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine __________ awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 하루 종일 소식을 불안하게(anxiously) 기다렸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② anxiously(불안하게): "Throughout the day" + 아픈 고양이 소식 대기 → 불안한 감정
❌ ① indifferently(무관심하게): 반대 감정
❌ ③ cheerfully(기쁘게): 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ reluctantly(마지못해): 기다리기를 꺼리는 것이 아님
❌ ⑤ carelessly(부주의하게): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: anxiously awaited = 불안하게 기다렸다 — 걱정하는 주인의 심정

questions.passage: Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually __________ his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시간이 지나며 Leo가 기력과 활기를 되찾았다(regained).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ regained(되찾았다): "recover" + "gradually" → 점차 회복
❌ ① lost(잃었다): 반대 의미
❌ ② abandoned(포기했다): 반대 의미
❌ ③ wasted(낭비했다): 문맥과 반대
det.tip: regained = recovered = got back = 되찾다 — "gradually"는 점진적 회복의 단서

questions.passage: Back at home, Christine created a __________ (comfort) space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: comfort(명사) → comfortable(형용사): 명사 space를 수식하는 형용사 필요
det.analysis:
comfort(명사) → comfortable(형용사)
a + 형용사 + space → a comfortable space = 편안한 공간
det.tip: comfort → comfortable(형용사) / comfortably(부사)

questions.passage: The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor __________. (infect)”
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: infect(동사) → infection(명사): a minor 뒤에 명사 필요
det.analysis:
infect(동사) → infection(명사)
a + minor(형용사) + 명사 → a minor infection
det.tip: infect → infection(명사) / infected(형용사) — 관사+형용사 뒤 = 명사

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 Christine이 Leo를 데려간 장소를 본문에서 2단어로 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital" → 동물병원
det.analysis: take him to the animal hospital → 데려간 장소 = animal hospital
det.tip: 장소를 묻는 질문: 전치사(to) 뒤의 명사구 확인

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 Christine이 Leo를 병원에 남기는 것을 받아들인 이유를 나타내는 3단어 표현을 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "she had to accept it was for the best" → 최선이라서
det.analysis:
accept it was for the best → 최선을 위해
for the best = 결국 가장 좋은 것을 위해
det.tip: for the best = 최선을 위해 — "accept + it was for the best" 구문

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: "it's best for Leo to stay here" → 수의사가 검사를 위해 병원에 머물 것을 제안했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 수의사가 검사를 위해 병원에 머물 것을 제안: 원문 일치
❌ ① 수술 언급 없음
❌ ② "she always brought Leo to this hospital" → 항상 가던 병원
❌ ④ "administer the medication" → 약을 투여함
det.tip: 내용 일치: 선택지의 핵심어를 본문과 대조

ch: Christine은 Leo를 처음 가는 병원에 데려갔다.
수의사는 Leo의 검사를 위해 병원에 머물 것을 제안했다.

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: "the phone rang and it was the vet" → Christine은 수의사의 전화를 받았다. "전화를 받지 못해 직접 갔다"는 본문과 반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 전화를 받지 못해 직접 감: 원문은 전화를 받고 안도한 뒤 데리러 간 것
✅ ② "The waiting room was filled with other pet owners" → 일치
✅ ③ "provided detailed instructions on how to administer" → 일치
✅ ④ "Leo gradually regained his strength" → 일치
det.tip: 불일치: 인과관계를 왜곡한 선택지 주의 — 전화를 "받은 후" 간 것

ch: Christine은 수의사의 전화를 받지 못해 직접 병원에 갔다.
수의사는 약 투여 방법을 자세히 안내했다.

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Christine patted Leo with love and attention at home."

det.korean: "She patted him with love and attention" → Christine은 집에서 사랑과 관심으로 Leo를 쓰다듬었다. → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: 원문 "Back at home" + "She patted him with love and attention"과 일치
det.tip: T/F: 장소(at home)와 행동(patted with love)을 본문과 정확히 대조

questions.passage: __FULL__
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"The vet was unsure about Leo's condition because it was the first time seeing him."

det.korean: 본문: "she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo" → 수의사는 Leo를 잘 알고 있었다. 처음 본 것이 아님. → False
det.analysis:
❌ False: "always brought Leo to this hospital" + "vet knew well about Leo" → 처음이 아님
진술의 "first time seeing him"은 본문과 반대
det.tip: "always" + "knew well"은 반복 방문을 뜻함 → "first time"과 모순
